description: OLE-ERROR lifetime on a read/write copy: a Command's failing INSERT (duplicate key) is executed; the Errors collection is retained with Item(0) and Item(1) (Number, Description, SQLState); then Errors.Clear and the retained Error's Number; release of the Command and the retained Error's Description; a successful SELECT and the retained Number; Connection Close and the retained Number; release of the Connection and the collection and the retained Number, Description and SQLState. A second Connection fails, retains its Error and is released without Close. Asks what a retained error object returns after each owner transition.
retentionNote: Designed r-oledb-odbc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
